content: अच्छ, -च्छा {%ind.%} <ab>Ved.</ab> To, towards (with <ab>acc.</ab>). It is a kind of separable preposition or prefix to verbs and verbal derivatives, especially to such as imply some kind of motion, or speaking; (अच्छ गत्यर्थवदेषु <ls>P. I. 4. 69</ls>); ˚इ or गम् to go to, attain, as अच्छ गत्य; ˚नश्-क्ष् to go near, approach; ˚नी to lead towards; ˚नु to call out to; ˚पत् to fly towards रघुः श्येनः पतयत् अन्धः अच्छ <ls>Rv. 5. 45. 9</ls>. ˚वन्द् to salute; ˚वच् to invite Śabara interprets the word अच्छ in the text यूपमच्छेष्यता होतव्यम् to mean, ‘in order to have’; अच्छशब्दो हि आप्तुमित्यर्थे वर्तते . <ls>ŚB. on MS. 10. 1. 9</ls>.
